title: Sunflower Oil Exports Halved in a Single Month
subtitle: The closure of the Azov basin cut July shipments by more than half against June, and a further steep decline is expected in August.

source.name: Russian vegetable oil export and price statistics

data.label: Exports, July against June
data.annotation: The most abrupt break in the series, coinciding with the loss of Azov shipping.

data.label: Exports, August expectation
data.annotation: A further decline of about 40% is expected as routes stay closed.

data.label: Raw sunflower price, domestic
data.annotation: Prices soften at home as export outlets disappear.

supportingFacts.label: Managers at a leading plant-oil producer were detained in connection with the drone-manufacturing arrests reported earlier.
With exports blocked, the surplus stays in the domestic market and pushes farm-gate prices down.

metadata.keyFinding: Sunflower oil exports fell 53.9% month over month with a further 40% decline expected.
